examples: Mmm, this is a tasty pie!

senses.definition: (onomatopoeia) An expression used to show thought, reflection, or confusion.
examples: Mmm, I see what you mean.

quotes.text: In his final years he [John Ogdon] gave an interview to an American journalist who noticed that “his handshake is a boneless fadeaway. His response to a lengthy anecdote from a close friend is likely to range from a non-committal ‘Mmmmmmm’ to a rare ‘Very interesting’.”
quotes.reference: 2014 May 11, Ivan Hewett, “Piano Man: a Life of John Ogdon by Charles Beauclerk, review: A new biography of the great British pianist whose own genius destroyed him”, in The Daily Telegraph (Review), page R27:

senses.definition: (onomatopoeia) Used to represent an utterance that is muffled or spoken with a full mouth (also spelled "mmph").

quotes.text:
Danny: Have you got any food?
I: Mmm! As a matter of fact, got a saveloy.
